description: The line plot illustrates the mean absolute values of hidden states across different layers, comparing values before and after gating, as well as against a baseline. The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 24, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled “Abs Mean,” also uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 5, with tick marks at intervals of 1. The blue dashed line, representing the “hidden state mean before gate,” begins near 0.1 at layer 0, remains relatively flat until layer 10, then rises gradually to approximately 0.9 at layer 20, and surges sharply to about 4.5 by layer 24. The orange dotted line, representing the “hidden state mean after gate,” starts near 0.05 at layer 0, remains nearly flat across all layers, and ends slightly below 0.1 at layer 24, with a very slight dip after layer 15. The green solid line, representing the “hidden state mean of baseline,” stays consistently near 0.04 across all layers, showing minimal variation. The legend in the top left clearly identifies each line and its corresponding average value over all layers: 0.71 for before gate, 0.05 for after gate, and 0.04 for baseline.
